input.title: Table: Overflows the right edge of screen
input.body: Reduce the width of the window to emulate mobile screen size. ## Steps to Reproduce ``` - X - =view - Table - Does localhost:3012 use a different IndexedDB sandbox? - PORT=3012 - Can localhost connect to the staging2 server? - Yes, just change REACT_APP_WEBSOCKET_HOST ``` ## Current Behavior The table overflows the right edge of the screen. ## Expected Behavior Either one or both of the columns should wrap so that the table does not extend beyond the right edge of the screen.
